photos.depicts: Wide view down the white-topped bar counter with red under-glow, chrome tractor-seat stools and tiled floor, shelves glowing at back
photos.desktop_crop: Use full bleed as hero; works at 16:9 as is. Keep counter diagonal in frame
photos.mobile_crop: Crop to 4:5 centered on x 30-60% to keep the counter and nearest stools; the red glow is the focal point

photos.depicts: Bartender behind the glowing counter, backlit bottle shelves, red flowers hanging top, stools in foreground
photos.desktop_crop: Good 4:3 or crop to 16:9 trimming bottom 15%
photos.mobile_crop: Crop 4:5 centered x 45-80% on bartender and shelves, keep flowers if possible

photos.depicts: Close up of the bar top with spirit bottles, glasses and a bartender behind, warm bokeh lights
photos.desktop_crop: Too tall for wide hero; use as side panel or crop 16:9 around middle band (y 30-65%)
photos.mobile_crop: Use as is for 3:4 or 4:5 card, focal point upper middle (bottles and glasses)

photos.depicts: Dark room with brass chandelier, hanging red flowers and bar counter with stool on tile floor
photos.desktop_crop: Crop 16:9 at y 15-60% to keep chandelier and bar; moody section background
photos.mobile_crop: Native portrait is ideal; focal point chandelier top and counter lower center

photos.depicts: Upright piano covered in vintage stickers and posters, white keys sweeping diagonally
photos.desktop_crop: Crop 16:9 along diagonal around y 35-80%, keys and stickers
photos.mobile_crop: Use as is, focal point stickers upper left and keys lower right

photos.depicts: Sticker covered piano shot from the keyboard end with reflections, deep shadow
photos.mobile_crop: Native portrait, subject top left; text safe area bottom right

photos.depicts: Vintage corner with ornate carved mirror, chandelier, teal wall and wooden furniture in low light
photos.desktop_crop: Side column image or crop 4:3 around mirror (y 20-70%)
photos.mobile_crop: Native portrait; focal point mirror center-left

photos.depicts: Founder style portrait of a smiling person at the bar with pink flowers overhead and bronze ornament, tiled grey wall
photos.mobile_crop: Crop 4:5 centered x 35-65% to keep person and flowers

photos.depicts: Tractor-seat bar stool and bar edge in shadow on checkered floor, minimal moody detail
photos.mobile_crop: Native portrait; subject center, lots of dark negative space for overlay text

photos.depicts: Entrance side with a big weathered timber slab gate, tropical plants, railing and a person standing, daylight
photos.desktop_crop: Crop 16:9 around y 15-80%; good for location or story section

tropical_origin.reason: Facebook shows 'This content isn't available' / 'Log in to view this 18+ content' to logged-out visitors on every route tried (photos, photos_by, main page, m. host). A login by the user is required.
